features.evidence: Provider-neutral events, Pi and Vercel adapters, immutable run journals, and the one-release native fallback are present.
The public desktop owns the reviewed cyan and mint shell, compact composer, and four-item navigation.
A failed supervisor handoff is recorded canonically, attempted once, surfaced to the user, and degrades to continued local generation.
Desktop health checks cover CLI, MLX/VLM, ConversationRuntime, and desktop versions; contextual failures offer the single managed CLI repair path while offline operation remains available.
Image bytes are validated and stored atomically with private permissions under content hashes; SQLite keeps references only, legacy data URLs migrate on reopen, and previews hydrate after restart.

The app owns background download tasks across navigation, exposes stable whole-snapshot progress and pause controls, preserves partial files through cancellation, errors, and restart, resumes only from an exact HTTP Range boundary, and safely restarts when an origin ignores or mismatches that boundary. Incomplete snapshots remain blocked from serving until atomic finalization.

Experiments opens a one-frame local review over immutable canonical Pi journals, showing the small-model partial, stored intervention reason, teacher or post-nudge output, tool evidence, verdict confidence, and one explicit human action label.

The authenticated desktop API and `understudy desktop supervision export` project canonical journals into content-addressed owner-only correction-pair JSONL with tool results, verdict probability evidence, optional human judgment, exact run identity, and per-role usage. Metrics report intervention precision, false-positive nudges, small-model output share, and supervisor overhead while excluding incomplete attribution instead of treating it as zero; bounded evidence windows disclose every truncated journal or intervention.

The public CLI and desktop now provide destination-bound opt-in GLM 5.2 review over bounded pre-intervention evidence, exact served-model validation, private content-addressed analysis caching, offline-safe fallback, and explicit human judge-quality feedback. A frozen fail-closed promotion suite is public and dry-run verified; a fresh live 10+ case provider run is still required before recommending the advisory by default.
GEPA, RLM, custom eval, and benchmark capabilities exist, but the reviewed benchmark, ledger, and comparison experience is not one coherent surface.

The legacy desktop source is explicitly extraction-only: its stale npm package is private, both archived Tauri apps have bundling disabled, and a trusted-base PR guard rejects additions or modifications while allowing deletion or auditable shelving. The public apps/homescreen remains the sole desktop release authority.
Deletion waits for the full genuine-run observation gate and conformance proof from the canonical runtime.
